selected_evidence.summary: Signed xinetd package installed; wait=no service points to the supplied handler; xinetd is enabled, active, listening on 9097, and firewalld permits the port.
PING returned PONG; HELLO and an empty line returned ERROR.

Twelve held connections produced twelve distinct handler PIDs and clean exits. A final post-restart run completed 16/16 concurrent PONG requests with zero non-PONG responses and zero remaining handlers.
